mapper.select:
SELECT goods_no, goods_code, goods_name, goods_price, goods_discount, poster_url, subposter_url, b.brand_name, hit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_like gl WHERE gl.goods_no=g.goods_no) as like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r WHERE r.goods_no=g.goods_no) as review_count FROM goods g JOIN brand b ON g.brand_no=b.brand_no
g.category_no = #{category_no}
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(g.goods_price, '[^0-9]', '')) ASC
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(g.goods_price, '[^0-9]', '')) DESC
ORDER BY g.hit DESC
ORDER BY g.goods_no ASC
OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY

SELECT goods_no, goods_name, goods_code, goods_price, goods_discount, poster_url, subposter_url, hit, b.brand_name, c.category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_like gl WHERE gl.goods_no=g.goods_no) as like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r WHERE r.goods_no=g.goods_no) as review_count FROM goods g JOIN brand b ON g.brand_no = b.brand_no JOIN category c ON g.category_no=c.category_no WHERE g.goods_no=#{goods_no}

g.category_no=#{cno} AND
g.goods_name LIKE '%'||#{fd}||'%'
ORDER BY g.goods_no DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (cart_no, id, stock_no, sizes, quantity, created_at) VALUES (cart_no_seq.nextval, #{id}, #{stock_no}, #{sizes}, #{quantity}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT review_no, subject, content, id, hit, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as dbday FROM review WHERE goods_no = #{goods_no} ORDER BY review_no DESC
SELECT qna_no, subject, content, id, type, status, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as dbday FROM qna WHERE goods_no = #{goods_no} ORDER BY qna_no DESC
